description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 01.04.2019 to 07.04.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It rescinds a previous notification and sets legally binding exchange rates. This content falls squarely under legal/regulatory matters as it constitutes a statutory instrument and regulatory framework for customs operations, making it Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazette).
